25.stem:
다음 파이썬 프로그램의 실행 결과는?

class NodeBS(object):

    def __init__(self, vl = None):

        self.vl = vl

        self.root = None

        self.lf = None

        self.rg = None

    def _ad(self, vl):

        nd = NodeBS(vl)

        if vl > self.vl:

            self.rg = self.rg and self.rg._ad(vl) or nd

        elif vl < self.vl:

            self.lf = self.lf and self.lf._ad(vl) or nd

        else:

            print("node duplicated")

        return self

class Bst(NodeBS):

    def add_node(self, vl):

        if not self.root:

            self.root = NodeBS(vl)

        else:

            self.root._ad(vl)

    def order(self):

        current = self.root

        nodes, stack = [], []

        while stack or current:

            if current:

                   nodes.append(current.vl)

                  stack.append(current)

                  current = current.lf

            else:

                  current = stack.pop()

                  current = current.rg

        return nodes

if __name__ == "__main__":

    bt = Bst()

    in_list = [6, 4, 8, 2, 5, 7, 9, 1, 3, 10]

    for i in in_list:

        bt.add_node(i)

    print(bt.order())

다음 파이썬 프로그램의 실행 결과는?

def search(arr, target):

    low, high = 0, len(arr) - 1

    while low <= high:

        mid = (low + high) // 2

        if arr[mid] == target: return mid

        elif arr[mid] < target: low = mid + 1

        else: high = mid - 1

    return -1

 

if __name__ == "__main__":

    print(search(a, 23))

19.stem:
다음 파이썬 프로그램의 실행 결과는?

cnt = 0

class Node:

    def __init__(self,key,h,lf = None,rg = None):

        self.key = key

        self.h = h

        self.lf = lf

        self.rg = rg

class TREE:

    def __init__(self):

        self.r = None

    def h(self, n):

        if n == None:

            return 0

        return n.h

    def put(self, key):

        self.r = self.putitem(self.r,key)

    def putitem(self, n, key):

        if n == None:

            return Node(key, 1)

        if n.key > key:

            n.lf = self.putitem(n.lf,key)

        elif n.key < key:

            n.rg = self.putitem(n.rg,key)

        else:

            return n

        n.h = max(self.h(n.lf),self.h(n.rg)) + 1

        return self.bal(n)

    def bal(self, n):

        global cnt

        if self.bf(n) > 1:

            if self.bf(n.lf) < 0:

                  n.lf = self.lf(n.lf)

                  cnt += 1

            n = self.rg(n)

            cnt += 1

        elif self.bf(n) < -1:

            if self.bf(n.rg) > 0:

                  n.rg = self.rg(n.rg)

                  cnt += 1

            n = self.lf(n)

            cnt += 1

        return n

    def rg(self, j):

        i = j.lf

        j.lf = i.rg

        i.rg = j

        j.h = max(self.h(j.lf),self.h(j.rg)) + 1

        i.h = max(self.h(i.lf),self.h(i.rg)) + 1

        return i

    def lf(self, j):

        i = j.rg

        j.rg = i.lf

        i.lf = j

        j.h = max(self.h(j.lf),self.h(j.rg)) + 1

        i.h = max(self.h(i.lf),self.h(i.rg)) + 1

        return i

    def bf(self, n):

        return self.h(n.lf) - self.h(n.rg)

if __name__ == '__main__':

    t = TREE()

    value = [5, 22, 3, 14, 2, 19]

    for i in value:

        t.put(i)

    print(cnt)
